comparisons.reason: The two features measure different constructs. Feature 0 returns 1 if any comment directly rebuts or argues against the OP's view, which is a stance judgment. Feature 1 returns 1 if any comment contains a quotation that matches OP title or argument text. It explicitly does not require endorsement or refutation. A comment can quote the OP without countering, and can counter without quoting. Their null and empty-list rules also differ: feature 1's spec contradicts itself on empty lists, while feature 0 does not.
